metadata.chapter: Chapter 94 - STREETS, SIDEWALKS AND CERTAIN OTHER PUBLIC PLACES

content.title: Chapter 94 - STREETS, SIDEWALKS AND CERTAIN OTHER PUBLIC PLACES — Sec. 94-122. - Street light location.
content.summary:
The traffic engineer shall determine the general location and type of lights necessary
               to illuminate public streets and other public ways within the city.
(Code 1960, § 21-17; Code 1981, § 30-119)
